report.clinical_summary: Patient with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia on Venetoclax 400 mg daily (maintenance phase, started 6 months ago) with completed Obinutuzumab. Symptoms include persistent fatigue, lymphadenopathy (neck, axilla, groin, pea-sized, non-painful, possibly worsening), unintentional weight loss (5 kg over past year), and Venetoclax-associated headaches. Lymphocyte count has dropped significantly but patient not in complete remission. Patient expresses high concern about disease progression and uncertainty about the future.
